title: AWS Certification Curriculum Manifest
description: Defines a single AWS certification's prep curriculum as a composition over the shared lesson library (aws/curriculum.json) plus cert-specific additions. Lessons are referenced, never copied.

code.description: Official AWS exam code, e.g. SAA-C03. Use as the canonical cert identifier everywhere.

name.description: Official cert name, e.g. AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate

short_name.description: Display shorthand, e.g. Solutions Architect Associate

retires_on.description: Last day to test, if retiring/retired.

blueprint_version.description: Version string from the AWS exam guide, e.g. 1.1

exam.description: Logistics metadata, all sourced from the official exam guide.

prerequisites.description: Exam codes recommended/required before this one.

domains.description: The exam's content domains, in official order, each with its scored weight and an ordered lesson playlist.

title.description: Official domain title, e.g. Design Secure Architectures

tasks.description: Task statements within the domain, each mapped to lessons that teach it.

lessons.description: Ordered lesson references that cover this task.

cert_specific_lessons.description: Lessons unique to this cert that do NOT belong in the general path. Authored under aws/certs/<code>/lessons/. Listed here as a backlog with status.

question_bank.description: Pointer to this cert's practice questions, mapped to the same domains/tasks so practice tests can be blueprint-weighted.

blueprint_weighted.description: True once question distribution matches domain weights.

coverage.description: Optional computed/curated coverage summary, used to surface gaps in the UI and to gate 'exam-ready'.

ref.description: Reference to a lesson. Shared library: '<module-slug>/<file>'. Cert-specific: 'certs/<code>/lessons/<file>'.

emphasis.description: How heavily this exam leans on the lesson. Drives study-time estimates and review prioritization.

note.description: Cert-specific framing, e.g. 'Focus on cross-account STS, not console basics.'
